name: Aureate
description: A gilded burst: a fine fan of rays inside a plain rim, the two of them separated by a gap.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 6deg, transparent 6deg 18deg), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 18%, #000 0); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 6deg, transparent 6deg 18deg), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 18%, #000 0); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 88%, #000 88%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 88%, #000 88%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
